title: Local Marketing: A Complete Guide | Salesforce

facts.fact: Salesforce's own research says 80% of shoppers consider the experience a company provides just as important as its products or services.
facts.quote: 80% of shoppers say that the experience a company provides is just as important as its products or service.

facts.fact: In the page's illustrative (hypothetical) bakery example, a broad citywide online ad campaign with a $1,000 budget reached 10,000 people.
facts.quote: This campaign reaches 10,000 people, but only 100 of them convert into customers, resulting in a conversion rate of 1%.

facts.fact: In the page's illustrative bakery example, a $1,000 budget spent on Facebook ads targeting residents within a 5-mile radius of the storefront was the local campaign.
facts.quote: invest the same $1,000 in targeted Facebook ads specifically aimed at residents within a 5-mile radius of their storefront.

facts.fact: In the page's illustrative bakery example, the 5-mile-radius local Facebook campaign reached 2,500 people.
facts.quote: This localized campaign reaches only 2,500 people, a quarter of the audience of the broad campaign.

facts.fact: In the page's illustrative bakery example, the local campaign converted 200 customers, raising the conversion rate to 8%.
facts.quote: 200 people convert into customers, doubling the conversion rate to 8%.

facts.fact: Salesforce's State of Marketing report draws on responses from nearly 5,000 marketers worldwide.
facts.quote: See the top trends in data, AI, and more — from nearly 5,000 marketers worldwide.

facts.fact: Instagram tends to skew slightly older than TikTok, with a growing user base of millennials and Gen Xers.
facts.quote: Instagram, for example, tends to skew slightly older than TikTok, with a growing user base of millennials and Gen Xers.

facts.fact: TikTok has gained immense popularity among Gen Z users, particularly for its short-form video content.
facts.quote: TikTok, on the other hand, has gained immense popularity among Gen Z users, particularly for its short-form video content.

facts.fact: Facebook may generally cater to an older demographic, but certain local communities or niche interest groups may still be highly active on it.
facts.quote: While Facebook may generally cater to an older demographic, certain local communities or niche interest groups within your area may still be highly active on the platform.

facts.fact: Instagram and Snapchat offer geotagging features that let users tag their location when posting content.
facts.quote: Platforms like Instagram and Snapchat offer geotagging features that allow users to tag their location when posting content.

facts.fact: Facebook lets businesses create and promote local events and join community pages relevant to their area.
facts.quote: Facebook provides opportunities for businesses to create and promote local events, as well as join community pages relevant to their area.

facts.fact: Many social media platforms offer advertising targeting based on user location, including geo-targeted ads for specific neighborhoods or regions.
facts.quote: Many social media platforms offer sophisticated advertising targeting options, including the ability to target users based on their location.

facts.fact: The page recommends claiming business listings on Google My Business, Yelp, and Facebook.
facts.quote: Claim your turf on popular platforms like Google My Business, Yelp, and Facebook

facts.fact: The page gives long-tail local keyword examples such as "best coffee shop in [city]" and "plumber near me."
facts.quote: Think long-tail keywords packed with location-specific phrases like "best coffee shop in [city]" or "plumber near me."

facts.fact: The page gives an example local bakery title tag format of "Freshly Baked Goods | [Bakery Name] | [City, State]."
facts.quote: Freshly Baked Goods | [Bakery Name] | [City, State]

facts.fact: The page's local hardware store example faced an uptick in DIY projects during the pandemic and responded with a series of how-to videos on social media.
facts.quote: faced an uptick in DIY projects during the pandemic. Recognizing the community's need for guidance and support, the store launched a series of how-to videos

facts.fact: The page recommends tracking engagement, reach, click-through rates, and conversions to evaluate each social platform's effectiveness.
facts.quote: Track metrics such as engagement, reach, click-through rates, and conversions to evaluate the effectiveness of each platform.

facts.fact: Salesforce's page defines local marketing as a strategy focused on targeting consumers within a specific geographic area, aiming to attract customers who are physically near a business.
facts.quote: Local marketing is a strategy focused on targeting consumers within a specific geographic area, aiming to attract customers who are physically near a business.

facts.fact: Salesforce's page describes local SEO as optimizing a business's online presence to rank higher in local search results.
facts.quote: Local SEO optimizes a business's online presence to rank higher in local search results, making it easier for nearby customers to find directions, contact info, and reviews.

facts.fact: Salesforce's page lists common local marketing strategies as local SEO (such as Google My Business optimization), local social media campaigns, local advertising, community event sponsorships, and direct mail to local addresses.
facts.quote: Common strategies include local SEO (such as Google My Business optimization), local social media campaigns, local advertising, community event sponsorships, and direct mail to local addresses.

facts.fact: Salesforce's page suggests measuring local marketing success with Google My Business insights (views, calls), local website traffic, customer inquiries from local sources, and direct sales from local promotions.
facts.quote: Success can be measured by metrics like Google My Business insights (views, calls), local website traffic, customer inquiries from local sources, and direct sales from local promotions.

facts.fact: Salesforce's page recommends that a local partnership be backed by a written agreement outlining roles, responsibilities, and key performance indicators (KPIs) to prevent misunderstandings and disputes.
facts.quote: Establishing a written agreement outlining roles, responsibilities, and key performance indicators (KPIs) can help prevent misunderstandings and disputes down the line.

facts.fact: Salesforce's page lists benefits of local marketing as increased local brand awareness, higher foot traffic, more qualified local leads, improved customer retention from the community, and positive word-of-mouth.
facts.quote: Benefits include increased local brand awareness, higher foot traffic, more qualified local leads, improved customer retention from the community, and positive word-of-mouth
